📋 What is UNIBEN Post UTME?

The University of Benin (UNIBEN) Post UTME is a supplementary screening examination conducted by the University of Benin, Ugbowo, Edo State, Nigeria. It is held annually for candidates who applied to UNIBEN through the Joint Admissions and Matriculation Board (JAMB) and scored at or above UNIBEN's minimum cut-off mark.

The exam is conducted as a Computer-Based Test (CBT) and tests candidates in Use of English plus subjects relevant to their chosen course of study. Performance in this exam — combined with JAMB score — determines who gets admitted.

  • Format: Computer-Based Test (CBT), Multiple Choice
  • Duration: Typically 60–90 minutes depending on faculty
  • Questions: 40–60 questions per sitting
  • Minimum JAMB Score to Participate: 180+ (varies by course)

📚 UNIBEN Post UTME Subject Combinations

Use of English is compulsory for all candidates. The additional subjects depend on your faculty:

Faculty / Course GroupPost UTME Subjects
Engineering & TechnologyEnglish, Mathematics, Physics, Chemistry
Medicine & PharmacyEnglish, Biology, Chemistry, Physics
Sciences (Pure)English, Mathematics, Biology/Chemistry/Physics
LawEnglish, Government/CRS/Literature
Social Sciences & ManagementEnglish, Economics, Mathematics
Arts & HumanitiesEnglish, Literature, Government or History
EducationEnglish + subjects related to teaching subject

🏆 How to Pass UNIBEN Post UTME (Expert Tips)

📅

Start Early

Begin preparation immediately after JAMB. Most candidates only have 4–8 weeks. Don't waste that time.

🖥️

Practice CBT Daily

UNIBEN tests are on computer. Get comfortable with the CBT format — time pressure is real. Use our free simulator.

📖

Study Past Questions

80% of UNIBEN Post UTME questions are repeated or adapted from previous years. Past questions are your best resource.

⏱️

Master Time Management

Aim for 60–90 seconds per question. Skip hard ones, return later. Finish all questions before time runs out.

📐

Focus on Weak Areas

After each practice session, review wrong answers. Spend extra time on topics where you score below 50%.

💪

Exam Day Calm

Sleep early the night before. Arrive at the centre early. Read each question carefully — don't rush the first minute.

🎯 UNIBEN Cut-Off Marks & Admission Score

UNIBEN uses a combined scoring system: your JAMB score + Post UTME score determine admission. The exact formula and weights are set by the university each year.

  • JAMB minimum (general): 180/400 to participate in screening
  • Medicine & Surgery: JAMB 250+, very high Post UTME score required
  • Law: JAMB 220+, competitive Post UTME
  • Engineering: JAMB 200+, moderate-to-high Post UTME score
  • Arts & Social Sciences: JAMB 180–200+

Pro tip: Even if your JAMB score is average, an excellent Post UTME score can compensate. Scoring 70%+ in Post UTME significantly boosts your admission chances.

❓ Frequently Asked Questions

What is the UNIBEN Post UTME cut-off mark? ▼
UNIBEN's Post UTME cut-off varies by faculty. Engineering and Medicine require 200+ in JAMB plus a high Post UTME score. Arts and Social Sciences courses typically have lower cut-offs around 180. Always check UNIBEN's official admission list for the current year's figures.
How many subjects are in UNIBEN Post UTME? ▼
UNIBEN Post UTME tests Use of English (compulsory) plus 2–3 other subjects relevant to your chosen course. Science courses include Physics, Chemistry, Mathematics or Biology. Arts courses include Literature, Government, or Economics.
Is UNIBEN Post UTME computer-based (CBT)? ▼
Yes. UNIBEN conducts its Post UTME screening as a Computer-Based Test (CBT). Candidates answer multiple-choice questions on a computer within a set time limit. Practising on a CBT simulator like ours is strongly recommended.
Can I use UNIBEN past questions to prepare? ▼
Absolutely — and it's the #1 strategy. Studies show that up to 80% of Post UTME questions are repeated or adapted from previous years. Practising past questions gives you familiarity with question patterns, reduces exam anxiety, and helps you manage time better.
When is UNIBEN Post UTME 2024/2025? ▼
UNIBEN Post UTME dates are announced after JAMB results are released, usually between June and September. Check UNIBEN's official website (uniben.edu.ng) or the JAMB portal for the latest schedule.
